Info.title: Foster model
Info.desc: Coupled Foster model fitted on the sensor labels of every training board, parameters regressed over the condition (pfFoster.py)
Info._note: Edit the values only. Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored. 'CHANGE' marks parameters that depend on the computer (GPU memory, runtime); all other values are those of the paper.

Mdl._K: RC pairs: number of time constants tau_k (shared by all chips and sensors)
Mdl._Ts: Sampling time: sampling time of the profiles (s)
